added_failure_derivation: Derived with reckon.crew.review.added_failures_from_gate_logs over the reviewed run's own arms: baseline_suite log logs/base-arm.log (revision bb45e47e0, 6 failed / 27 passed, EXIT=1) reduced against /tmp/reckon-crew-scratch arms/base and after_suite log logs/head-arm.log (revision 6d75c489e, 1 failed / 32 passed, EXIT=1) reduced against the recorded head tree; the head arm's only failing id is one the base arm also fails, so the added set is empty.
assertion_note: The gained commit is documentation only and adds no assertion, so no added assertion can compare a value against the variable the test supplied.

findings.text: The Measure paragraph states 'Both arms are git archive extractions on node-local disk' while the same paragraph's closing sentence and logs/head-arm.log:2 both record the head arm as a worktree copy; the gained commit edited this file and left the false sentence standing, so the evidence record contradicts its own log.

Each arm's header records only the file it mutates ('# mutation: reckon/flight.py') and never the change itself, and the mutated file is restored between arms, so no arm is reproducible from the log and a reader cannot tell a targeted contract change from a file that was simply broken.
